note: The bounded catalog. A feature not listed here cannot appear in a spec. A feature listed here must have an emitter and an assertion.

crud.label: Create, read, update, delete
crud.assertion: creating a record and reloading the page shows the record in the list

search.label: Search across declared fields
search.assertion: typing a query that no record contains hides every record

export.label: Export as JSON and CSV
export.assertion: the export handler produces text that parses as JSON with one row per record

import.label: Restore from a JSON file
import.assertion: importing a previously exported file restores the same record count

theme.label: Dark and light theme, remembered
theme.assertion: toggling the theme and reloading keeps the chosen theme

pwa.label: Installable, offline manifest
pwa.assertion: the document carries an inline manifest and no external URL

tags.label: Tag chips on each record
tags.assertion: a record saved with two tags shows two chips

filters.label: Facet filters per select or tag field
filters.assertion: selecting a filter value shows only records carrying that value

sort.label: Sort by any column
sort.assertion: sorting by a field reorders the rendered list

stats.label: Count and summary strip
stats.assertion: the summary count equals the number of records rendered

reminder.label: Due dates with an overdue flag
reminder.assertion: a record with a past due date renders an overdue marker

print.label: Print stylesheet
print.assertion: the print stylesheet hides controls and keeps the list

i18n.label: Second language toggle
i18n.assertion: switching language changes at least one rendered label and sets the html lang attribute

backup.label: One-click full backup and restore
backup.assertion: a backup file restored into an empty store reproduces every record

derived.label: Derived metrics: streak, average, goal percent
derived.assertion: a tracker with three consecutive days logged shows a streak of 3

chart.label: Inline sparkline, no library
chart.assertion: the sparkline is inline svg with one point per day in the window

progress.label: Progress: how many are done, as a count and a percentage
progress.assertion: two of four rows done shows 2 of 4 and 50%

toggle.label: Toggle a boolean from the row, without opening the form
toggle.assertion: ticking the box on a row saves immediately and moves the progress bar

formula.label: A formula over named inputs, evaluated without eval

a11y.label: Accessibility: skip link, focus ring, live regions, reduced motion
a11y.assertion: pressing Tab from the top reaches a skip link before the header buttons

feedback.label: Size and backup banners, and a live status region
feedback.assertion: over 2000 rows the app says so and offers an export

convert.label: Convert between units of one dimension
convert.assertion: 1 kilometre converts to 0.62 miles and back again

steps.label: A form in steps, validated one step at a time
steps.assertion: a three step wizard shows Back only from the second step and Save only on the last

detail.label: Read one record in full, without opening the form
detail.assertion: clicking a row title opens the record read-only, with its long text as paragraphs

totals.label: A running total of one numeric field
totals.assertion: two entries of 30 and 90 minutes show a total of 2h

board.label: A board of columns from one select field
board.assertion: three records in two stages show two columns, with the counts on the headers

calendar.label: A month grid over one date field
calendar.assertion: a record dated the 13th appears in the cell for the 13th of that month

directory.label: A search-first directory: one box, cards, no toolbar
directory.assertion: opening the app puts the cursor in the search box and shows the count, not the rows

comparison.label: A fixed-column comparison table with the best value marked
comparison.assertion: the cheapest price shows a mark, and a row that is not cheapest shows none

multi.label: More than one list in one app, with a switcher
multi.assertion: two entities show a switcher, and switching keeps each list's own rows

dashboard.label: A strip of metric cards across one or more entities
dashboard.assertion: two tasks and one note show 2 and 1 on two cards

relation.label: A field that points at a record in another list
relation.assertion: a visit pointing at a patient shows that patient's name, not an id

balance.label: A running balance per parent, from its children
balance.assertion: three movements of +10, -3 and -2 show a balance of 5 on the item

timeline.label: The list grouped by month, newest first
timeline.assertion: two records in November and one in October show two month headings

quiz.label: A question at a time, a pick, and a score at the end
quiz.assertion: three questions with two right answers show 2 of 3 at the end

gallery.label: A grid of cards, each with an image
gallery.assertion: four records with image urls show four cards, each with an img element
